name: Cowell et al. complete English Jātaka commentary translation
source_edition: E. B. Cowell (ed.), The Jātaka: or Stories of the Buddha’s Former Births, translated by Robert Chalmers, W. H. D. Rouse, H. T. Francis, and R. A. Neil, Cambridge University Press, volumes I–VI, 1895–1907.

license_evidence.basis: The original printed translations were published in 1895–1907. Smithsonian Libraries marks its digitized Cowell volumes as No Copyright—United States and states that the works are public domain and may be copied, modified, and distributed. SuttaCentral identifies the legacy Cowell story translations and states that they are public domain.
license_evidence.scope_note: Rights apply to the original published translation. This import preserves attribution and source links; no modern commentary or newly translated text is added.

scope: All 547 numbered Jātaka articles across six volumes, imported as complete source units. These are commentary-story translations with canonical verses in context, not verse-only translations.
